name: Agent Deep Modeling Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/internal-packages/agent/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/app/api/chat/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/features/sessions/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/internal-packages/agent/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/app/api/chat/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/features/sessions/**'

jobs:
  test-agent-workflow:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./frontend

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build internal packages
        run: npm run build --workspace=@liam/agent

      - name: Run Agent Workflow Tests
        run: npm test --workspace=@liam/agent -- --testPathPattern="workflowSetup|agent"

      - name: Run Chat API Route Tests
        run: npm test --workspace=app -- --testPathPattern="api/chat"

      - name: Run Session Creation Helpers Tests
        run: npm test --workspace=app -- --testPathPattern="sessionCreationHelpers"

      - name: Verify Timeline Item Sync Removal
        run: |
          # Ensure withTimelineItemSync is no longer imported or used in workflowSetup.ts
          if grep -r "withTimelineItemSync" frontend/internal-packages/agent/src/shared/workflowSetup.ts; then
            echo "Error: withTimelineItemSync should be removed from workflowSetup.ts"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Verification passed: withTimelineItemSync removed from workflowSetup.ts"

      - name: Check for immediate message saving in Chat API
        run: |
          # Verify that createTimelineItem is called in the chat route before workflow execution
          if ! grep -q "createTimelineItem" frontend/apps/app/app/api/chat/route.ts; then
            echo "Error: createTimelineItem call not found in chat route.ts"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Verification passed: Immediate message saving implemented in chat route"

      - name: Check for immediate message saving in Session Creation Helpers
        run: |
          # Verify that createTimelineItem is called in sessionCreationHelpers.ts
          if ! grep -q "createTimelineItem" frontend/apps/app/features/sessions/components/shared/services/sessionCreationHelpers.ts; then
            echo "Error: createTimelineItem call not found in sessionCreationHelpers.ts"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Verification passed: Immediate message saving implemented in sessionCreationHelpers"
